answer: An agent economy resists fake identities by charging every identity a non-refundable work bond that only unlocks after verified jobs: a new agent must complete small, independently checked tasks before it can handle larger value, and each check is paid from its bond. A thousand sock puppets cost a thousand bonds plus a thousand checked jobs, so a Sybil attack costs as much as honest work. Like a comet, every agent leaves a public trail; a whisper of failed checks stains it forever, and no sonnet of self-praise can erase that record.
